zh: 我打到一半忘記存檔，結果全部重來了
intent: Forgot to save the game midway and had to start over.

zh: 這個遊戲可以隨時存檔嗎
intent: Asks whether the game can be saved at any time.

zh: 存檔點就在魔王房間前面
intent: The save point is right before the boss room.

zh: 今天沒趕上直播，晚點看存檔
intent: Missed the live stream; will watch the archive later.

zh: 直播存檔會保留多久呢
intent: Asks how long the stream archive stays up.

zh: 剛剛開台那段的存檔還看得到嗎
intent: Asks whether the archive of the part just streamed is still viewable.

zh: 我要先把遊戲進度存起來
intent: Game context without the word 存檔; must not become an archive.

zh: さくら今天的歌好好聽
intent: A hiragana handle stays in hiragana.

zh: 謝謝みこ一直陪我們聊天
intent: A hiragana handle stays in hiragana.

zh: ユキ的新衣裝超可愛
intent: A katakana handle stays in katakana.

zh: 和さくら、ねね一起玩的那集最好笑
intent: Two hiragana handles both stay as written.

zh: 加油！只剩最後一關了
intent: Only the final stage remains.

zh: 這一關的魔王好難打
intent: This stage's boss is hard.

zh: 第三關的機關要怎麼過
intent: How to get past the gimmick in stage three.

zh: 下一關會更難嗎
intent: Will the next stage be harder?

zh: 拜託不要停更，我每天都在等更新
intent: Please don't stop updating; waits every day.

zh: 不要停更啦 🥺
intent: Don't stop updating, pleading tone.

zh: 系統停更了三天，現在恢復了
intent: A statement that updates stopped for three days; not a request.

zh: 謝謝你回覆我，問題已經解決了
mustContainAny: ありがとうございます
ありがとうございました
intent: Thanks for the reply; the problem is solved. Polite throughout.

zh: 謝謝你一直這麼努力
intent: Thanks for always working so hard.

zh: 今天也辛苦了，好好休息喔
intent: Good work today too; rest well.

zh: 生日快樂！今年也會一直支持你
intent: Happy birthday; will keep supporting you this year.

zh: 我明天不會來，你們玩得開心點
intent: Writer will not come; readers should enjoy themselves.

zh: 你不用跟我道歉啦
intent: The reader need not apologize.

zh: 我會努力不讓你失望
intent: The writer will try not to disappoint; not a request.

zh: 別擔心我，我已經好多了
intent: Don't worry about me; I'm much better.

zh: 我沒有生氣喔 😊
intent: Negation plus emoji: not angry.

zh:
週末可能會晚一點開台
但一定會來
intent: Might start late on the weekend, but will definitely come; two lines.

zh:
今天很開心 🎉
下次見 👋
intent: Two lines, each with an emoji.

zh: 我還不確定能不能參加
intent: Not yet sure whether able to join.

zh: 這不是我的錯，是網路太卡了
intent: Not my fault; the connection lagged.

zh: 我們的關係很好
intent: 關 in 關係 is not a stage.

zh: 燈的開關在門旁邊
intent: 開關 is a switch.

zh: 銀行存款不夠了
intent: 存款 is money saved, not a save file or archive.

zh: 把檔案存到桌面就好
intent: Save a file to the desktop; not a stream archive.

zh: 直播間今天人好多
intent: The stream room is crowded; no save or archive.
